# Quick helper to understand stack ordering
# For sumloop: (forall ρ; ρ xs:Seq Int^many i:Int^many acc:Int^many -- ρ result:Int^many)
# Stack bottom to top: [ρ, xs, i, acc]
# So push order should be: xs, i, acc (bottom to top)
# In main we do: 0 0 xs sumloop
# So we're pushing: 0 (first), 0 (second), xs (top) = stack top-to-bottom: [xs, 0, 0]
# But we need: [xs, 0, 0] bottom-to-top which is: xs at bottom, 0 in middle, 0 at top
# So we need: xs 0 0

print("Fixed order examples:")
print("sumloop expects bottom-to-top: xs i acc")
print("So call as: xs i acc sumloop")
print("")
print("countloop expects bottom-to-top: xs k i count")
print("So call as: xs k i count countloop")
EOF
